game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing, a blinding salt flat: the scarab scholar must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what vultures changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing: a blinding salt flat
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Week 6 examination practice: Maze 9 (19×13, 45 junctions): collect 3 crystal(s) from the branches and reach beacon (11, 11). Use a C main program to Program synthesis. Print [2]; final file-scope values must be {}.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Salt Flat Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about trace_clarity to power up the scarab scholar and open the temple door.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Print Tracer – Salt Flat Crossing Streak
hint: Use printf with stdio.h. File-scope declarations belong before main; block locals hide names only within that block. Coordinates start at the top left.
